The paper proposes a framework for business optimization using APSO and SVM.
The framework combines APSO to find optimal kernel parameters for SVM.
The authors apply the framework to three case studies: production optimization, income prediction, and project scheduling.
The results show that the proposed framework can efficiently solve complex optimization problems and achieve accurate results.
The Cobb-Douglas production optimization problem is a classical problem that aims to minimize the utility function subject to a constraint on labor costs.
The proposed framework can efficiently solve the Cobb-Douglas production optimization problem with noise.
The results of the case studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework in solving complex optimization problems and achieving accurate results in business optimization.
